input.overview: Stop the clock with the four upper-right S-T-O-P targets, then knock down the single right drop and repeat the right orbit to raise Bonus X. The right orbit also lights the far upper-left saucer; collect the built bonus there because a drain does not collect it. If time is short, clear the left drops and complete the exposed T-I-M-E-R standups for 25 more time units.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the upper-right S-T-O-P targets, then use the right orbit to build Bonus X and light the far upper-left Collect Bonus saucer. Shoot that saucer to cash the bonus. Clear the left drops and complete T-I-M-E-R when you need 25 more time units.
input.summary: Stop the clock with S-T-O-P, build Bonus X at the right orbit, and cash the bonus at the far upper-left saucer. For more time, clear the left drop bank and complete the exposed T-I-M-E-R standups.

steps.text: Hit the four upper-right S-T-O-P standups to stop the running clock.
Knock down the single drop guarding the right orbit, then repeat that orbit to advance Bonus X and build base bonus.
Shoot the far upper-left Collect Bonus saucer after the right orbit lights it; this is the scoring collect, because a drain does not cash bonus.
When time is low, clear the left drop bank and complete the exposed T-I-M-E-R standups for 25 more time units.

alternatives.title: Use temporary playfield multipliers
alternatives.when: Use this when the top A-B-C-D lanes are close to completion during a controlled orbit feed.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D once for 2x playfield scoring.
Complete A-B-C-D again while 2x is running for 3x playfield scoring; the multiplier does not increase the Collect Bonus award.
Keep the clock stopped while right-orbit shots raise Bonus X toward 5x.
Take the upper-left saucer before a dangerous feed costs the current multiplier.

machineSetup: Confirm starting time, tilt-time penalty, score awards, Special and Extra Ball conversions, and whether temporary 2x and 3x scoring are enabled.
Test all four S-T-O-P targets, both green clock-start rollovers, the left drops and T-I-M-E-R standups, right drop and orbit, upper-left saucer, top A-B-C-D lanes, and both flippers.

playfieldReferences.label: S-T-O-P targets
playfieldReferences.description: The four upper-right standups that stop the clock when completed.

playfieldReferences.label: Right orbit
playfieldReferences.description: The orbit behind a single drop target that builds Bonus X and lights Collect Bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: Collect Bonus saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The far upper-left saucer that cashes bonus and adds time when lit.

playfieldReferences.label: T-I-M-E-R bank
playfieldReferences.description: The left standups exposed after the adjacent drops are cleared.

cautions.issue: The two green star rollovers restart the clock, and running out of time does not end the current ball immediately.
cautions.response: Rebuild time before the drain; the game ends when the ball drains with no time remaining.
